description: This file implements classes for handling filesystem interactions for checkpoint storage using fsspec. It includes classes for reading and writing checkpoints via fsspec-backed filesystems, with functionalities such as creating streams, renaming, directory management, and validation of checkpoint IDs.

classes.name: FileSystem
classes.description: A wrapper around an fsspec-like AbstractFileSystem providing utility methods for managing files and paths.

classes.name: FsspecWriter
classes.description: A class for writing checkpoints to a filesystem using fsspec, handling file creation and metadata.

classes.name: FsspecReader
classes.description: A class for reading checkpoints from a filesystem using fsspec.
